parallel.requirements: Recognized the Python-to-Node ESM migration, /output placement, no external dependencies, manual argparse behavior, whoosh analyzer, schema, indexing, parser, search, and executable probing requirements.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: Parent performed initial black-box exploration, then split implementation across four child owners for analysis/fields, qparser, index, and pyargs, retaining entry-file integration and final verification.
parallel.implementation: Children wrote distinct modules under /output/lib; the parent wrote test15.mjs importing those modules. The analyzer contract and implementation omitted parent-known stop word when.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: Parent received the AgentSwarm aggregate result, wrote an integrated entry file, listed all mjs artifacts, and delivered /output/test15.mjs plus the library modules.
parallel.verification: Children ran module self-tests; parent ran a 52-case differential script and treated the two help-output program-name differences as acceptable, but did not include the known when stop-word case.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: Official evaluation failed 13 of 70 tests. The directly evidenced coordination miss is the incorrect delegated stop-word contract missing when; broader qparser edge cases may also be ordinary implementation gaps.

serial.requirements: Recognized the same ESM, argv, no-dependency, /output, black-box, whoosh analyzer, parser, index, and search requirements without delegation.
serial.plan_and_ownership: Single agent kept research, implementation, integration, and verification ownership, using a todo list and repeatedly editing the same artifact set as new findings appeared.
serial.implementation: Wrote analysis, schema, index, qparser, pyint, argparse, and test15 modules directly, then fixed stop words, NOT grouping, large integer handling, and argparse double-dash behavior.
serial.integration_and_delivery: The serial artifact contained test15.mjs and six library modules; all integration happened locally in one trajectory with no child handoff or join boundary.
serial.verification: Ran a broad differential corpus that reached 184/184 stdout and exit-code matches, separate argparse checks, then a 400-case fuzz script that still found 18 query mismatches.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: The serial process timed out immediately after the fuzz mismatches and before another fix cycle; official evaluation also failed 13 of 70 tests.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel recognized the ESM migration and whoosh behavior requirements, but passed a supposedly complete analyzer stop-list contract that omitted parent-known when.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial recognized the same requirements and eventually edited its analyzer stop list to include when, though it still left other parser edge cases unresolved.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel lost one known task requirement at a child brief boundary; serial retained local ownership of that fact but timed out with other remaining mismatches.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel decomposed into four child module owners while the parent owned probing, shared contracts, final entry assembly, and final checks.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial kept all probing, module writing, integration, and verification in the main trajectory with no subagents or child ownership split.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The parallel split increased handoff dependence for correctness facts; serial avoided that boundary but spent much more time on one critical path.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel supplied explicit module interfaces, but the shared analyzer context declared a complete 31-word stop list without when despite prior parent observation.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had no child interface handoff and later edited the analyzer stop list in-place after further probing.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The material context difference is a missing task fact in the parallel child contract, not an incompatible component API.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel children implemented separate analysis, fields, qparser, index, and pyargs modules from the delegated contracts, including a 31-word analysis list.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial wrote a larger local implementation and then performed repeated edits for stop words, NOT operators, big ints, and double-dash parsing.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel reached an integrated implementation faster but baked in an incomplete analyzer contract; serial iterated deeper on edge behavior before timeout.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: All four child results returned through one AgentSwarm aggregate result, and the parent proceeded to entry-file assembly and final response.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: There were no child results; the main serial trajectory was later interrupted by timeout after starting a next step following fuzz mismatches.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had a completed child-result lifecycle, while serial had no join boundary but had an interrupted main lifecycle after unfinished verification findings.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel children wrote distinct assigned files and the parent wrote the entry file importing those modules, with no observed same-file collision.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial wrote and edited all files itself, producing a single artifact tree with test15.mjs and local libraries.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No shared-state collision explains the outcome; the important parallel issue is incorrect context transfer rather than write interference.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel ran module self-tests and a 52-case differential script, then accepted the build after treating only help program-name differences as expected.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial ran much broader differential and argparse checks, then discovered 18 remaining fuzz mismatches before timeout.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel acceptance was narrower and missed known stop-list and parser coverage; serial exposed more residual defects but did not have time to fix them.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel completed before timeout and officially evaluated the delivered artifact at 57/70.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial exceeded the agent budget, was cancelled, and its then-current artifact still evaluated at 57/70.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel closed voluntarily with a shallower acceptance check; serial closed by timeout after a deeper but unfinished fix cycle.

outcome_analysis.explanation: The current official completed status records are not discordant: both runs failed with 57/70 passed. The parallel run failed after a coordinated implementation that accepted a child-produced analyzer missing parent-known when and after limited final verification. The serial run repaired more edge cases, including a stop-list correction, but timed out after a fuzz run still showed 18 query mismatches. The same official score means the retained parallel coordination pattern is an adverse process finding, not an outcome-differential explanation.
parallel_contributors: Parent-known stop-word fact when was omitted from the child analyzer contract and final accepted artifact.
Final parallel verification covered 52 curated cases and did not exercise the omitted when stop-word case or broader fuzz mismatches.
serial_contributors: Serial retained single-agent context and corrected the analyzer stop list to include when.
Serial timed out after discovering but not fixing 18 fuzz mismatches in query parsing/search behavior.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Both implementations still had ordinary qparser/search edge-case gaps relative to the official hidden tests.
Serial traceback stderr differed for numeric range failures but stdout and exit code matched in its local check.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: parallel adverse contributor only; no official outcome difference
